Row.Text: The bone-rank system governs Silla life. Power descends by ancestry; one’s spouse, profession, clothing, wealth, status, and worth as a person emanates from deep within. But as Silla expands, it incorporates those from outside of the system whose families are unknown, and customs strange.
They must be governed by Silla nobles of good families and proper seonggol. Keep the system.
Bone-rank must be more flexible. Let us call it cartilage-rank.

New advances in biology have yielded results: a quantification of bone-rank. This allows Silla nobility to definitively prove their superiority over commoners. There is one complication: many noble houses have members that repeatedly fail the test, thus disqualifying them from advancement.
Surely there must be something wrong with the test.
Surely there must be something wrong with the nobles.
